result.rationale: The diff shows `<%- end if %>` in app/views/embed/best.html.erb (line 8 of the new file). ERB compiles this to the Ruby fragment `end if ` — a trailing `if` modifier with no condition — producing syntactically invalid Ruby. The template's conditionals (`<%- if ... %>`, `<%- else %>`, plus the `if` after `end`) do not balance with the single `<%- end if %>` closer, so ActionView raises SyntaxError on first render of the success path (posts present), breaking /embed/best with a 500 exactly where the embed feature is supposed to work.

judged_text: The trailing `if` in `<%- end if %>` opens a new unterminated conditional (the template emits 4 `if/do` opens against only 3 `end`s), so best.html.erb compiles to syntactically invalid Ruby. ActionView raises a SyntaxError the first time the template is compiled: every /embed/best request for a URL with an existing topic — and every 30-second reload that loading.html.erb triggers once the retrieve job creates the topic — returns a 500 instead of the comments list, so the entire embed feature is dead on its success path; rspec-rails controller specs do not render views, so CI cannot catch it.
